translation.title: Shopping & Pop-ups in Seongsu
translation.summary: A practical guide to Seongsu's fast-changing mix of fashion, beauty, lifestyle stores and temporary pop-ups.
translation.body_markdown:
# Shopping & Pop-ups in Seongsu

Seongsu is one of Seoul's most active neighborhoods for fashion, beauty, lifestyle retail and temporary brand experiences.

## Permanent stores and temporary pop-ups are different

A permanent flagship store may operate for years, while a pop-up may last only a few days or weeks.

Do not assume that a social-media post means the event is still running.

## Where to explore

The streets around Seongsu Station and Yeonmujang-gil are useful starting points. From there, explore nearby side streets rather than following only one main road.

## Before visiting a specific pop-up

Check the brand's latest official announcement for:

- event dates
- opening hours
- reservation requirements
- waiting or entry procedures
- age or purchase restrictions, if any

## Shopping strategy

If you have limited time:

1. Pick one or two must-visit stores.
2. Leave extra time for unexpected pop-ups.
3. Avoid crossing the neighborhood repeatedly.
4. Group stops that are close together.

## Tax refunds

Tax-refund availability depends on the individual store and purchase conditions. Ask the store before paying if this matters to you.

## Local tip

Seongsu changes quickly. Treat your saved map as a starting point, not a fixed itinerary.
